findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Employees were observed donning gloves without handwashing in between tasks. Education was carried out and the behavior was abolished. Ensure that staff are reminded to always wash their hands before donning gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Soil accumulation was observed on the interior of the ice machine. Upon the day of the follow up the ice machine was in the same state as the previous inspection. A follow up has been scheduled for Monday November 9th to ensure the ice machine is clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following:
- Soil accumulation was observed on the interior of the ice machine.
- The soda gun at the bar was observed to have soil accumulation on nozzle.
PIC was made aware and cleaned the soda nozzle to correct the violation. A follow up has been scheduled for Friday, October 30th to ensure the ice machine is clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a dried on spill of food residue inside the microwave in the kitchen. PIC was informed and will direct staff to clean the microwave to correct the violation. Ensure that surfaces and equipment are cleaned frequently to avoid accumulation of soil and debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed:
1.(REPEAT) The coving trim tiles along the wall right of the mop sink and near the ice machine was observed fallen off the wall.
2. Accumulation of dust in the walk in cooler around the fans and walls was observed.

PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that these spaces are sealed appropriately providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the mop to be stored in the mop sink. PIC was made aware and the mop was moved to have the bristles hanging to dry. Ensure that mops are positioned to allow them to air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an employee drink cup on a shelf in the kitchen without a lid and straw. PIC was informed and the drink was removed to correct the violation. Ensure that employee drinks are covered with a lid and straw to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment:
The metal board sealing the door of the walk-in cooler was observed not properly sealing the gap under the walk-in cooler door. This gap was observed during facility’s routine inspection on 6/4/2026. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the  gap will be fixed allowing the door to seal cooler properly. 
Ensure that this gap is closed to avoid food spoilage and a damage to the cooling unit.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that these spaces are sealed appropriately providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
